description: You are an electrical engineering technician preparing the electrical drawings for a residential building permit. Open the garage floor plan at '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan.dxf' in LibreCAD. The building permit requires complete electrical drawings including a panel schedule. Your task is to overlay a complete residential electrical panel schedule on the floor plan. The overlay must include: (1) a panel schedule table with circuit numbers and circuit descriptions organized on an 'E-PANEL' or equivalent dedicated layer, (2) branch circuit annotations (circuit numbers or wiring notes) on a dedicated circuit layer, (3) load calculation values showing watts, VA, or amperage for circuits, (4) the main breaker or panel rating annotation (e.g., '200A MAIN', '100 AMP PANEL'), (5) at least 4 different circuit descriptions representing typical residential branch circuits (LIGHTING, RECEPTACLES, HVAC, DRYER, KITCHEN, GARAGE, etc.), and (6) electrical notes or specifications text. Save the completed drawing to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan_electrical.dxf'.
